name: Build and Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "v*"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: "macos-latest"
            arch: "aarch64"
            os: "darwin"

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.platform }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          submodules: false

      # parakeet.cpp (patched for the Omi Med STT adapter) - pinned commit e8acc617
      - name: Checkout parakeet.cpp and apply Omi adapter patch
        run: |
          git clone https://github.com/mudler/parakeet.cpp.git src-tauri/parakeet.cpp
          cd src-tauri/parakeet.cpp && git checkout e8acc6172a94e20a952cf1843decace5d771a94b
          EXPECTED="e8acc6172a94e20a952cf1843decace5d771a94b"
          ACTUAL=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          if [ "$ACTUAL" != "$EXPECTED" ]; then
            echo "❌ SHA mismatch: expected $EXPECTED, got $ACTUAL"
            exit 1
          fi
          git submodule update --init --recursive
          git apply --recount ../parakeet-cpp-omi-adapter.patch
          rm -rf src-tauri/parakeet.cpp/.git

      # llama.cpp b9437
      - name: Checkout llama.cpp
        run: |
          git clone https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp.git src-tauri/llama.cpp
          cd src-tauri/llama.cpp && git checkout aa46bda89b9a8378ae76bb15fc2ce2f571f0983c
          EXPECTED="aa46bda89b9a8378ae76bb15fc2ce2f571f0983c"
          ACTUAL=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          if [ "$ACTUAL" != "$EXPECTED" ]; then
            echo "❌ SHA mismatch: expected $EXPECTED, got $ACTUAL"
            exit 1
          fi
          rm -rf src-tauri/llama.cpp/.git

      - name: Import signing certificate
        env:
          APPLE_CERTIFICATE: ${{ secrets.APPLE_CERTIFICATE }}
          APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY: ${{ secrets.APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$APPLE_CERTIFICATE" ]; then
            echo "❌ APPLE_CERTIFICATE secret is not set"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "$APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD" ]; then
            echo "❌ APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD secret is not set"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "$APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY" ]; then
            echo "❌ APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY secret is not set"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Generate and mask keychain password
          KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD=$(openssl rand -base64 32)
          echo "::add-mask::$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD"

          security create-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" build.keychain
          security default-keychain -s build.keychain
          security unlock-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" build.keychain
          security set-keychain-settings -lut 3600 build.keychain

          echo "$APPLE_CERTIFICATE" | base64 --decode > certificate.p12

          security import certificate.p12 -k build.keychain -P "$APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD" -T /usr/bin/codesign
          rm -f certificate.p12

          security set-key-partition-list -S apple-tool:,apple: -s -k "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" build.keychain

          # Verify the identity is actually present before we waste time compiling
          if ! security find-identity -v -p codesigning build.keychain | grep -q "$APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY"; then
            echo "❌ Signing identity '$APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY' not found in keychain after import"
            security find-identity -v -p codesigning build.keychain
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "✅ Certificate imported and signing identity verified"

      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@631a55b12751854ce901bb631d5902ceb48146f7
        with:
          targets: aarch64-apple-darwin

      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.18.0"
          cache: "npm"

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@c771a70e6277c0a99b617c7a806ffedaca235ff9 # v9.0.0
        with:
          version-file: "server/pyproject.toml"

      - name: Install ccache and Homebrew Python
        run: brew install ccache python@3.12

      - name: Cache Nuitka and ccache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: |
            ~/Library/Caches/Nuitka
            ~/.cache/ccache
          key: nuitka-ccache-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('server/**/*.py', 'server/uv.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            nuitka-ccache-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Set up Python venv with uv
        run: |
          cd server
          uv sync --locked --extra rag --python /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.12

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build all components
        env:
          APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY: ${{ secrets.APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY }}
        run: ./build-all.sh

      - name: Build and notarize Tauri app
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          APPLE_CERTIFICATE: ${{ secrets.APPLE_CERTIFICATE }}
          APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY: ${{ secrets.APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY }}
          APPLE_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_ID }}
          APPLE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.APPLE_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}
        run: |
          npm run tauri -- build --target aarch64-apple-darwin -- --locked

      - name: Upload DMG
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: Phlox-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: src-tauri/target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/bundle/dmg/*.dmg

      - name: Attach to Release
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@3d0d9888cb7fd7b750713d6e236d1fcb99157228 # v3.0.2
        with:
          files: src-tauri/target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/bundle/dmg/*.dmg
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  build-flatpak:
    permissions:
      contents: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/flathub-infra/flatpak-github-actions:gnome-48@sha256:50fea670968fd3ec4aeeb3a91d9d807d0af6eab3c3b44c33d4c40c311832c8fa
      options: --privileged

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          submodules: false

      - name: Build Flatpak
        uses: flatpak/flatpak-github-actions/flatpak-builder@401fe28a8384095fc1531b9d320b292f0ee45adb # v6.7
        with:
          bundle: Phlox-linux-x86_64.flatpak
          manifest-path: packaging/com.phlox.app.yaml
          cache-key: flatpak-builder-${{ github.sha }}
          arch: x86_64
          verbose: true

      - name: Upload Flatpak bundle
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: Phlox-linux-x86_64.flatpak
          path: Phlox-linux-x86_64.flatpak

      - name: Attach to Release
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@3d0d9888cb7fd7b750713d6e236d1fcb99157228 # v3.0.2
        with:
          files: Phlox-linux-x86_64.flatpak
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  docker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@bb05f3f5519dd87d3ba754cc423b652a5edd6d2c # v4.2.0

      - name: Log in to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@dbcb813823bdd20940b903addbd779551569679f # v4.6.0
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GHCR_PAT }}

      - name: Extract version from tag
        id: meta
        run: |
          VERSION=${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}
          if [[ ! "$VERSION" =~ ^[0-9] ]]; then
            VERSION="2.0.0"
          fi
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Build and push
        uses: docker/build-push-action@53b7df96c91f9c12dcc8a07bcb9ccacbed38856a # v7.3.0
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          tags: |
            ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}:${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}
            ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}:latest
          platforms: linux/amd64
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

  notify-website:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
    needs: [build, build-flatpak, docker]
    steps:
      - name: Trigger phlox-website rebuild
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.WEBSITE_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          curl -sS -X POST \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
            -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
            https://api.github.com/repos/bloodworks-io/phlox-website/dispatches \
            -d '{"event_type":"phlox-released","client_payload":{"version":"'"${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"'"}}'

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: "30 17 * * *" # 3:30AM AEST (UTC+10)

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint:
    if: github.event_name != 'schedule'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.18.0"
          cache: "npm"

      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - run: npx vitest run

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Verify Docker uv versions match pyproject
        run: |
          UV_VERSION="$(python -c 'import tomllib; print(tomllib.load(open("server/pyproject.toml", "rb"))["tool"]["uv"]["required-version"].removeprefix("=="))')"
          for dockerfile in Dockerfile Dockerfile.dev Dockerfile.test; do
            if ! grep -Fq "ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:${UV_VERSION}@" "$dockerfile"; then
              echo "::error file=${dockerfile}::uv image must use version ${UV_VERSION}"
              exit 1
            fi
          done

      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@c771a70e6277c0a99b617c7a806ffedaca235ff9 # v9.0.0
        with:
          version-file: "server/pyproject.toml"
          enable-cache: true
          cache-dependency-glob: "server/uv.lock"

      - run: cd server && uv sync --locked
      - run: cd server && uv run ruff check . --output-format=github
      - run: cd server && uv run ruff format --check .
      - run: cd server && uv run ty check .

      - uses: suzuki-shunsuke/pinact-action@1081f5ad49ac904b7d977784f338145150a32112 # v1.4.0
        with:
          skip_push: "true"

  test:
    if: github.event_name != 'schedule'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Build Test Docker Image
        run: docker build -f Dockerfile.test -t phlox-test .

      - name: Run Tests in Docker Container
        run: |
          docker run --name test-container phlox-test
          docker cp test-container:/usr/src/app/coverage.lcov ./coverage.lcov
          docker rm test-container

      - uses: coverallsapp/github-action@8d6379e14d29928660c4ba802d8e85393440b329 # v2.3.8
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: coverage.lcov

  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.18.0"
          cache: "npm"

      - run: npm ci
      - name: Verify npm honors min-release-age cooldown
        run: test "$(npm config get min-release-age)" = "3"
      - name: npm audit
        id: npm-audit
        continue-on-error: true
        run: npm audit --audit-level=high

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@c771a70e6277c0a99b617c7a806ffedaca235ff9 # v9.0.0
        with:
          version-file: "server/pyproject.toml"
          enable-cache: true
          cache-dependency-glob: "server/uv.lock"

      - run: cd server && uv sync --locked --extra docker
      - name: pip-audit
        id: pip-audit
        continue-on-error: true
        run: cd server && uv run pip-audit --local --strict --skip-editable

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@631a55b12751854ce901bb631d5902ceb48146f7
      - name: cargo audit
        id: cargo-audit
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: rustsec/audit-check@69366f33c96575abad1ee0dba8212993eecbe998 # v2.0.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          working-directory: src-tauri

      - name: Fail if an audit found vulnerabilities
        if: always() && (steps.npm-audit.outcome == 'failure' || steps.pip-audit.outcome == 'failure' || steps.cargo-audit.outcome == 'failure')
        run: exit 1

name: Nightly Docker Build
on:
    schedule:
        - cron: "0 17 * * *" # 3AM AEST (UTC+10)
    workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
    contents: read
    packages: write
    actions: read

jobs:
    # --- JOB 1: Check if there are new commits ---
    check_changes:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        outputs:
            has_changes: ${{ steps.check.outputs.has_changes }}
        steps:
            - name: Determine if build is needed
              id: check
              run: |
                  # 1. Get the timestamp of the last SUCCESSFUL run of this exact workflow
                  # Note: Ensure "nightly.yml" matches the actual filename of this workflow!
                  LAST_RUN=$(gh api "repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/workflows/nightly.yml/runs?status=success" \
                    --jq '.workflow_runs[0].updated_at // "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"')

                  # 2. Get the timestamp of the latest commit on the development branch
                  LATEST_COMMIT=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/commits/development \
                    --jq '.commit.committer.date')

                  echo "Last successful run: $LAST_RUN"
                  echo "Latest commit: $LATEST_COMMIT"

                  # 3. Compare timestamps (Bash string comparison works perfectly for ISO8601)
                  # We also force 'true' if you clicked "Run Workflow" manually
                  if [[ "$LATEST_COMMIT" > "$LAST_RUN" ]] || [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" ]]; then
                      echo "has_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
                  else
                      echo "has_changes=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
                      echo "No new commits since last successful run. Skipping build."
                  fi
              env:
                  GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

    # --- JOB 2: Build & Push Docker Image ---
    docker:
        needs: check_changes
        if: needs.check_changes.outputs.has_changes == 'true'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - name: Checkout repository
              uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
              with:
                  ref: development

            - name: Set up Docker Buildx
              uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@bb05f3f5519dd87d3ba754cc423b652a5edd6d2c # v4.2.0

            - name: Log in to GitHub Container Registry
              uses: docker/login-action@dbcb813823bdd20940b903addbd779551569679f # v4.6.0
              with:
                  registry: ghcr.io
                  username: ${{ github.actor }}
                  password: ${{ secrets.GHCR_PAT }}

            - name: Build and push
              uses: docker/build-push-action@53b7df96c91f9c12dcc8a07bcb9ccacbed38856a # v7.3.0
              with:
                  context: .
                  push: true
                  tags: ghcr.io/bloodworks-io/phlox:nightly
                  platforms: linux/amd64
                  cache-from: type=gha
                  cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

- **FastAPI** is the core framework; it exposes a **React app**, a catch-all endpoint, and a test DB endpoint. An **ApiRouter** delegates to ~80+ API endpoints covering chat, document analysis, patient data CRUD, template management, transcription, MCP server config, and model management.
- **Data stores** include SQLite and SQLite3 – shown as isolated nodes with no inbound edges, implying they are accessed indirectly via endpoints (e.g., `/Commit To Vectordb`, `/Save Patient Data`).
- **Bearer Auth** protects many sensitive endpoints (health, patient data, database operations, audio, templates) – but not all. Several endpoints have **no protection** listed: `/Clear Database`, `/Delete Patient`, `/Delete File`, `/Update Document Metadata`, `/Generate`, `/Re Embed/Stream`.
- **Models** (O2, gpt-4, llama3.1:8b, qwen3-30b, Qwen3.5-0.8B) are used by FastAPI and LLM Clients – but no guardrails (e.g., output filtering, rate limiting) are shown between endpoints and these models.
- **Tool chain**: A `Connect` tool calls **user-configured MCP servers** – this is an outbound data leak risk if MCP servers are external. No auth or sandboxing is shown.
- **Risk pattern**: Unguarded endpoints (`/Clear Database`, `/Delete Patient`, `/Generate`, `/Re Embed/Stream`) allow direct data modification or inference without authentication, creating high-severity exposure for patient data and system state.
